# Idol Altars

by VisionGLLast Updated: March 25, 2026

### Advertisement

This website is supported by ads.

Idol Altars are a type of item that you equip above your Idol Grid to change the layout of the Grid. This introduces Refracted Slots into your Grid that provide bonuses to Idols within them, such as 10-50% Increased Effect of Prefixes or 10-50% Increased Effect of Weaver Enchantment Affixes. Idol Altars drop as loot when completing Omen Window encounters. Currently, there are thirteen Idol Grid layouts available through Idol Altars.

## Understanding Idol Altars

Idol Altars
Idol Altars are a type of base item that you equip to a slot above your Idol Grid. They change the layout of your Grid and introduce Refracted Slots. Each Idol Altar comes with a Corrupted Affix and the potential to have up to 2 Prefixes and 2 Suffixes.

Idol Altar Grid Layout and Refracted Slots

### Refracted Slots

In addition to changing the layout of your Idol Grid, new purple squares called Refracted Slots also appear when you equip an Idol Altar. Placing Idols into these Refracted Slots can unlock different bonuses depending on the Affixes on your Idol Altar. Some examples of Refracted Slot bonuses are +(2-12) Health per Idol in a Refracted Slot or +(6-33 ) Ward Decay Threshold per Idol in a Refracted Slot.

### Stats on Idol Altars

Each Idol Altar can have up to five Affixes that affect the Idols you have equipped. Up to 2 Prefixes, 2 Suffixes, and 1 guaranteed Corrupted Affix. Some Idol Altars even allow you to equip more than one Omen Idol.

Example of an Idol Altar

## Where to Find Idol Altars

Idol Altars
Acquire Idol Altars by completing Omen Window events within the Campaign or Monolith of Fate. Higher-Tier Omen Windows have a higher chance to drop rare Idol Altars.

### Omen Windows

Omen Windows are random encounters, similar to Nemesis and Rift Beasts. They are a horde-based mechanic, where you engage swarms of smaller Fractured Enemies before challenging a stronger Omen enemy. ## Idol Altar Implicits

Idol Altars
- Archaic Altar
- This is a basic Idol Altar; there are no special Implicits.

- Auric Altar
- 2% more Damage to Bosses per Equipped Unique or Legendary Idol.

- Carcinised Altar
- +(64-256) Armor per Idol in a Refracted Slot.

- Impervious Altar
- +(15-35) Ward Decay Threshold per Equipped Corrupted Idol. 2 Weaver Idols equipped at Maximum

- Jagged Altar
- 2 Weaver Idols equipped at Maximum.

- Lunar Altar
- This is a basic Idol Altar; there are no special Implicits.

- Ocular Altar
- 2 Adorned Idols equipped at Maximum.

- Prophesied Altar
- (10-40)% increased Effect of Suffixes for Idols in Refracted Slots.

- Pyramidal Altar
- 0.1 Increased Cooldown Recovery Speed if there are no larger idols above smaller ones in the grid. 2 Weaver Idols equipped at Maximum.

- Skyward Altar
- This is a basic Idol Altar; there are no special Implicits.

- Spire Altar
- +(7-24) Mana per Idol in a Refracted Slot.

- Twisted Altar
- This is a basic Idol Altar; there are no special Implicits.

- Visage Altar
- +(6-10) Health per Equipped Omen Idol.

## Summary

Idol Altars
- Idol Altars are a type of item that can slot above your Idol Grid and change the layout of the Grid.
- They drop from Omen Window encounters. Higher-Tier Omen Windows have a higher chance to drop rare Idol Altars.
- Idol Altars offer 13 different types of Idol Grid layouts.
- 9 of the 13 Idol Altar bases have special Implicit modifiers, such as +Health per Omen Equipped Omen Idol.
